description: SW-fps is a 15-hour face-to-face training programme developed by Armstrong and colleagues to prepare practising social workers to deliver brief cognitive-behavioural strategies for common mental-health disorders.
title: SW-fps

description: Switch-on Reading is a one-to-one, 10-week graded-book reading intervention developed for weak Year 7 readers and delivered by trained staff using a prescribed session protocol and running-record assessment.
title: Switch-on Reading
